disagreement_policy: Retain both independent judgments. Agreement is a provisional label; disagreement or abstention is unresolved, not a calibrated 0.5 probability. No arbitrary tie-break. Audit separately before training.
benchmark_policy: Existing habitat fragmentation and LLM post-training benchmarks are development diagnostics. New topic families and their test papers are excluded before training data collection. New benchmark labels are silver unless independently reviewed.
training_policy: Retrain from the public base weights, not the old fine-tunes; validation by family, no paper/text/title duplication between splits. Same-data comparison of 0.8B and 2B, with a matched-size Kimi-v1 baseline and a no-mining ablation. No automatic deployment or publication of weights.
